title: Pop-up claims a virus, call this number
symptom: Browser shows a loud warning that the PC is infected and gives a phone number
user_description: A big red screen says my computer has a virus and I must call a number immediately! It's making an alarm sound!

options.text: Call the number on the pop-up to check if it is real
options.why: The number belongs to the scammers. Calling starts the scam, where they pressure victims to give remote access or pay.

options.text: Click the button to download the recommended cleaner
options.why: The 'cleaner' is the real malware. Never follow instructions from a pop-up like this.

options.text: Tell her not to call or click anything, close the browser using Task Manager if needed, run a security scan and report it to the security team
options.why: Real security tools never ask you to phone a number. Closing the page, scanning and reporting protects her and the company.

options.text: Let the caller connect remotely to fix it
options.why: Giving remote access to scammers lets them steal data and install harmful software.

hints: Would a real antivirus ever tell you to call a phone number?
How can you close the page safely?
Who else should know about it?
real_world_tip: Ask whether she has already called or let anyone connect. If so, treat it as an incident and escalate straight away.
